methodology.engine: API-shaped TEST DOUBLE, not the user chess.js
methodology.audio: Test doubles, absent audio, and throwing-audio scenarios
methodology.artwork: Synthetic PNG test fixtures, deliberately missing files, real SVG fallbacks. Not the user artwork.
methodology.limitations: Does not verify the real chess engine, chess-rule correctness, actual audio playback, or supplied game artwork. The original breakage was not reproduced with the user engine, which was not supplied.

checks.name: Actual main.js starts in Chromium with the supplied API-shaped engine fixture
Board contains 64 squares and 32 ship tokens
Both static selectors contain every registered faction
Default factions preserved
Player and AI UI selections are independent
Board tokens use each selected faction
Both footer labels update
Available numbered PNGs are used
Missing numbered PNGs fall back to original PNGs
Preserved sizes applied to all player pieces
Real image transforms point White upward and Black downward
Both firing-side palettes route through the integrated selection map
Both sides may select the same faction
Real pointer events select and start a normal move animation
Both controls lock during a glide
Skipping player glide commits once and queues AI
AI fixture responds and controls unlock after animation
Undo replays through the existing engine API and preserves both factions
Save stores both IDs and full rule metadata
Load restores BOTH fleet selections and labels
Preferences are stored independently
Invalid load is rejected before changing game or factions
Old version-2 saves keep current player selection
Old add-on version-3 saves restore both choices
All registered fleet pairs resolve independently without changing chess state
Every original torpedo loadout is preserved for both actors
Full real battle update completes once and returns attacker to destination
Pointer capture starts a real battle with correct per-actor palettes
Faction colors are stored on fired beams for both roles
Real canvas draws non-transparent battle pixels
Battle locks both selectors
Capture completion updates score and captured count
New game cancels queued AI and preserves selected factions
Promotion dialog locks both faction selectors
Promotion choice is forwarded through the unchanged engine API
Mobile board fits available viewport width and arena height
Mobile HUD retains both visible selectors
No runtime prototype override or injected selector style is installed
No uncaught JavaScript page errors during desktop/mobile controller and battle checks
Missing every PNG resolves both sides to decoded SVG fallbacks
Missing PNGs still produce visible DOM ship images
Missing-artwork scenario has no uncaught JavaScript errors
Denied browser storage does not prevent independent selection
Denied saving is handled without losing the game
Missing optional audio disables audio controls without blocking startup
Blocked-storage / absent-audio scenario has no uncaught JavaScript errors
Throwing audio getVolume and resume methods do not abort startup
Throwing audio weapon callback does not abort fire
Broken-audio scenario has no uncaught JavaScript errors
Missing real engine dependency produces a visible startup diagnostic
Black-to-move load restores both factions before queued AI work
Unknown saved IDs fall back independently for each side
Reload restores both independent preferences
Resize during animation is deferred to prevent coordinate jumps
Deferred resize is applied when the move completes
Local file:// launch works in Chromium without an HTTP server or external services (engine/audio fixtures)
Local file scenario has no uncaught JavaScript errors
EP capture animation uses the actual victim square, independent of destination
